explanation: Combined result of the study-selection module and the HypoMap atlas client. studySelection.test.tsx tests the study-selection module at its interface, parameterized by report kind (empty selections never widen, selections survive a term remount, link bytes round-trip, the panel wording), importing the value and URL form from studySelectionLink.ts. lazyChunkBoundaries.test.ts walks the entry graph from main.tsx with the TypeScript 6 syntax tree and bundler resolution, skips only compiler-erased type imports, fails on unresolved relative runtime imports and fails if either evidence ledger is reachable. The App gene and pathway scope tests keep one copied-link smoke each; geneStudyScope.test.ts and the useCategoryScope tests are removed. hypomapAtlasClient.test.ts tests the HypoMap atlas client through its in-memory transport (checksums, gzip, cohort, resolution, shared per-symbol load, metrics, mean/SEM, CSV tables and their expression unit) and absorbs hypomapMetrics.test.ts, which is removed; hypomapFixture.ts builds the fixture export the preview, co-expression and csvDialog tests read.
